title: Navigate the built docs through a lazily loaded Pagefind dialog

hashes.pagefind_version: 1.5.2 (pinned; resolved through pnpm dlx — no package.json or lockfile change)

build.command: pnpm registry:build && pnpm gallery:manifest && pnpm --filter @rnr-ai-elements/docs build

index.observed: fail-closed destination check passes (56 items + 7 docs); real Pagefind CLI indexes 64 pages (63 expected destinations + the new docs-owned /components/streamdown dependency-explainer page), 1 language; pagefind-entry.json reports 64 pages.

red.observed: 10/15 cases fail at the missing search surface (locator('[data-search-slot] button') never resolves; no dialog, no Pagefind activation); 5/5 chromium-nojs cases pass because the no-JavaScript surface contract already holds pre-implementation.

green.observed: All 15 cases pass across chromium-desktop, chromium-mobile and chromium-nojs with retries 0: zero pre-activation /pagefind/ requests across browse/hover/soft-nav; dialog open <=300ms (in-page and transport clocks); same-origin pagefind.js loads exactly once; real index chunks load with the first query; unchanged reopen adds 0 requests; initialization survives ClientRouter soft navigation; one activation opens exactly one dialog; grouped components/ui/lib/pages results with matching aria-live counts; ArrowDown/Up single-step selection; Enter reaches /components/streamdown with HTTP 200 and its own h1 (now the docs-owned dependency-explainer destination); Escape restores invoker focus; the no-JS surface passes on chromium-nojs; empty-state recovery, literal-HTML query safety, and the real offline error case all pass.
green.canonical_gate: run_flow.py --flow FLOW-SHELL-15-search-contract-before-recovery --expect green: exit=0 artifact_fresh=True surface_ok=True coldboot_ok=True red_proof_ok=True -> PASS

supplementary_gates.search_index_vitest: pnpm exec vitest run tests/sprint-05-orient-search/search-index.test.ts — 5/5 pass (model coverage 56+7; real indexer exit 0; props/verdict/hidden-engine-panel text inside data-pagefind-body regions; fail-closed scratch removal names /components/conversation)
supplementary_gates.island_budget_vitest: pnpm exec vitest run tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/island-budget.test.ts — 3/3 pass (exactly five customElements.define incl. rnr-search-dialog; zero framework imports; theme/tab contracts preserved)
supplementary_gates.typecheck: pnpm typecheck — exit 0 (root tsc covers scripts/ and tests/, not Astro templates)
supplementary_gates.lint: ./node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome ci . — exit 0 (4 pre-existing warnings in untouched files); pnpm lint script dies locally (biome OOM), binary used directly

acceptance.AC-1: proven: all five item destinations (incl. /components/streamdown) and all three doc destinations reached through real searches at HTTP 200 with matching h1 content; categories components/ui/lib/pages observed; renderMarkdown and dev client return the boundary page plus item results; nearBottomThreshold finds Conversation; the emitted badge verdict is searchable and a distinctive emitted phrase finds its originating item.
acceptance.AC-2: proven (desktop + mobile): zero pre-activation Pagefind requests, <=300ms open on two independent clocks, exactly one same-origin module request, real index chunks with the first query, unchanged reopen adds zero requests, initialization survives soft navigation.
acceptance.AC-3: proven: single native dialog[aria-modal=true], input focus, matching aria-live count, single-step arrow selection, Enter reaching the pinned destination at HTTP 200, Escape restoring invoker focus, shortcut reopen after ClientRouter navigation; the JavaScript-disabled surface (hidden trigger, zero Pagefind requests, working links through /docs/introduction, /docs/installation, /registry) passes on chromium-nojs.
acceptance.AC-4: proven: run-specific no-match query yields the visible empty state and streamdown recovery restores results; the literal HTML-shaped query stays input text creating zero data-s05-query nodes/attributes; real offline failure yields exactly one visible error plus captured requestfailed events within the 300ms open budget with invoker focus restored; a fresh online context completes the search-and-follow.

known_blockers.blocker: Run-order hazard (inherited): any astro build wipes dist/pagefind; the task-owned indexer must run after the last build before any preview-backed lane. CI owns this ordering.

resolution: FIX-ORI-AST-004-1 (approved b8198956, merged b72e18e2, merged into this branch at 396c2ada) published the docs-owned /components/streamdown dependency destination; the 8 pinned streamdown legs were re-run green on the merged candidate.
cycle_2_fixes: search-dialog.ts: guard per-instance wiring against the relocation re-entry of connectedCallback (a doubled keydown listener moved the active result two steps per keypress, making arrow activation miss targets); reset the per-instance settled-query witness on swap-in so a fresh element cannot inherit the previous page settlements.

search-contract.spec.ts: replace the generic main-root success oracles with real content oracles (the registry ledger region, the indexed prose region, role=heading level 1) to satisfy the surface-entry lint.
